items.text: There is a lot of potential in this game. I can See the Developer was atempting to create a 'sims in space' game set in a world similar to the world of Unreal Turnament, however between starting ships that are 20 min to game over, and ships that spontaneously explode from what I can only asume are Patrol ships launching nukes for the sheer transgresion of starting up a derlect in the ship yard there are way too many kill states that feel as though they were up to RNG then acutal poor gameplay.
items.text_zh: 这款游戏潜力很大。我能看出开发者试图创造一款“太空版模拟人生”游戏，背景设定在一个类似《虚幻竞技场》世界的世界里，然而，从开局飞船 20 分钟就游戏结束，到飞船莫名其妙爆炸——我只能假设是巡逻船因为你在船坞里启动一艘废弃船这种纯粹的越界行为而发射核弹——有太多致死状态让人觉得更像是取决于随机数生成，而不是实际玩得差。

observations.description: 起始船只导致游戏在20分钟内结束
observations.evidence: starting ships that are 20 min to game over
observations.evidence_zh: 初始船只20分钟就游戏结束
